fusions.name: Forced March
fusions.desc: Marches your shield forward, dealing 12 damage to everything in a cone 3 tiles ahead and driving it 3 tiles back.

fusions.name: Heel Stamp
fusions.desc: Stamps the rim of your shield down on the target's foot, dealing 4 damage and leaving it 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Column Drill
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 15% for 15 seconds and your movement speed by 15% for 8 seconds, and breaks 1 root, freeze or slow on you.

fusions.name: Well-Trodden
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your armour rises by 12%.
